home.title: Your connection, in one place.
home.description: View subscriptions, traffic, devices, access links, payments, referrals, and support.

branding.title: Appearance
branding.description: The palette, the corners, the spacing, and the mark this installation renders under. Everything here is optional; what you leave unset stays the shipped design.
branding.resetHint: Clears every override. Nothing is stored until you save.

shape.title: Shape and modes
shape.description: Corner radius and spacing scale with the design rather than replacing it, so the relationship between a chip, a control, and a card survives the change.
shape.offeredHint: Turning one off removes the switcher from both surfaces instead of leaving a control that cannot take effect.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Six-digit hex values. An empty field keeps the design's own colour for that slot. The status tones — danger, success, warning — are not editable, because their meaning is what they communicate.

preview.label: Preview
preview.heading: Subscription renewed
preview.body: This is how ordinary text reads against your surfaces.

warnings.advisory: This palette falls short of WCAG 2.2 AA

assets.title: Brand images
assets.description: Up to {kilobytes} KB each, as {types}. SVG is not accepted: an SVG can carry a script, and these files are served from the same origin as the panel.
assets.empty: Not set — the shipped mark is used.
assets.tooLarge: That image is larger than {kilobytes} KB.

connect.title: Connection guidance
connect.description: The platforms and applications this installation recommends. The Telegram bot and the customer web panel read the same rows, so a change here changes both.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: What a customer picks from first. A platform that is not offered disappears from both surfaces rather than being shown greyed out.
platforms.empty: No platforms are offered, so neither surface can recommend anything. The subscription link is still copyable.
platforms.deleteWarning: Every application documented for this platform is deleted with it. Turning it off instead keeps the entries and hides the platform.

clients.description: Recommended in this order. The first one names the application in the setup steps.
clients.name: Application
clients.schemeHint: Ends up in a link, so it must look like happ://add/. javascript, data, vbscript, and file are refused.
clients.downloadHint: https only. Shown as a second button beside the import link.
clients.instructionsHint: Optional. Yours replace the generic three steps for this platform rather than being added to them.
clients.empty: No application is documented for this platform yet.

import.title: Import from Remnawave
import.description: Copy the applications your Remnawave subscription page recommends. Platforms are matched by key and applications by name, so importing again updates them; your other entries stay as they are.
import.skipped: Skipped, because their import link cannot be used safely: {names}.

commandMenu.title: Command menu
commandMenu.description: Jump to a page, find a customer, order, ticket, or code, or start a common action.

search.failed: Records could not be searched. Pages and actions still work.
search.rateLimited: Too many searches in a minute. Wait a moment.
search.handleNotStored: Telegram @usernames are not stored, so they cannot be searched. Use the numeric Telegram ID, the email, or the customer ID.

userMenu.label: Account menu
userMenu.languageFailed: The language could not be saved to your account; it is applied in this browser only.

states.sessionErrorDescription: The API did not answer. Check that it is running and reachable.
states.forbidden: You do not have access to this page
states.forbiddenDescription: Your roles do not include the permission this page requires. Ask an owner if you need it.
states.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?

home.description: How the business stands right now: customers, subscriptions, payments, and what is waiting for an operator.
home.accessDescription: The roles you hold and the permissions they grant. The API enforces exactly this set.

cards.operatorsDescription: Review who can sign in, and suspend an account when someone leaves.
cards.auditDescription: Search every recorded authentication, authorization, and configuration action.
cards.securityDescription: Manage your password, two-factor authentication, and active sessions.

home.noDashboardDescription: The operations dashboard needs the system.read permission. Your roles do not include it.

login.title: Sign in
login.challengeDescription: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.codeHint: You can also use one of your recovery codes.

errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: The API could not be reached.
errors.passkeyCloned: That passkey was refused: another device answered for it. The account has been notified.
errors.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys are not configured on this installation.
errors.passkeyExpired: That took too long. Try again.
errors.challengeEnded: Too many wrong codes, so that sign-in was ended. Enter your password again to get a new code prompt.

setup.title: Create the first owner
setup.description: This installation has no operator account yet.
setup.tokenHint: The setup token was printed to the API log when it started. It can be used once.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Length matters more than symbols.

operators.title: Operators
operators.description: Everyone who can sign in to this panel.
operators.emptyDescription: Only the owner account exists so far.

confirm.title: Suspend this operator?
confirm.description: They will be signed out everywhere immediately and will not be able to sign in again until reinstated.

toasts.lastOwner: The installation must keep at least one active owner.
toasts.statusFailed: The status could not be changed.

invite.title: Invite an operator
invite.description: They will choose their own name and password when they open the link.
invite.rolesHint: Roles you could not grant yourself are unavailable. The matrix below shows what each one allows.

roleHints.support: Customers, subscriptions, and the support desk

invite.issuedDescription: Send this link to {email} yourself — Omniflow does not email it.
invite.onlyOnceTitle: This is the only time the link is shown
invite.onlyOnce: Only a fingerprint of it is stored. If it is lost, invite the same address again: the new link replaces this one.
invite.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
invite.expires: Works once, until {date, date, medium} {date, time, short}.

errors.emailInUse: That address already has an operator account.
errors.escalation: You cannot invite somebody with authority you do not hold yourself.
errors.generic: The invitation could not be created. Try again.

roleEditor.title: Roles for {name}
roleEditor.description: Changes take effect on their next request. Roles you could not grant yourself cannot be added or removed.
roleEditor.notice: The change is recorded in the audit log and announced in the operator group.

errors.roles: An operator must hold at least one role. Suspend the account to take access away.
errors.lastOwner: The installation must keep at least one active owner.
errors.escalation: That change grants or removes authority you do not hold yourself.
errors.self: You cannot change your own roles.
errors.generic: The roles could not be changed. Try again.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.description: Links that have been issued and not yet used. The links themselves are not stored.
pending.emptyDescription: Invite an operator to add someone to this panel.
pending.revokeFailed: The invitation could not be revoked.
pending.confirmDescription: The link sent to {email} will stop working immediately.

matrix.title: Roles and permissions
matrix.description: What each built-in role may do. This is the same table the API enforces.
matrix.error: The permission catalogue could not be loaded

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every authentication, authorization, and configuration action, newest first. The trail is append-only.
audit.emptyDescription: Actions will appear here as operators use the panel.
audit.noMatchesDescription: Try widening or clearing the filters.
audit.error: The audit log could not be loaded

security.title: Security
security.description: Your password, two-factor authentication, and the devices signed in to your account.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: A passkey signs you in on its own, without a password or a code.
passkeys.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without typing a password.
passkeys.labelHint: Only you see this name. It is there to tell one device from another when you revoke a key.
passkeys.removeWarning: “{label}” will no longer sign you in. Your password and second factor still work.
passkeys.unavailableDescription: A passkey is bound to a public address, and this installation has not set APP_PUBLIC_URL.
passkeys.unsupportedBrowserDescription: Your keys are still listed here and still work in a browser that supports them.

errors.load: Your passkeys could not be read.
errors.register: That passkey could not be added.
errors.unverified: That authenticator did not check who was using it, so it cannot sign in on its own. Turn on a PIN or a fingerprint for it and try again.
errors.rename: That name could not be saved.
errors.remove: That passkey could not be removed.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: A code from your authenticator app, required at every sign-in.
twoFactor.recommendDescription: This account controls customer data and money. A password alone is not enough.
twoFactor.scanHint: Add this secret to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.disableWarning: Your account will be protected by a password alone. Confirm with your password.
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: These are shown once. Each can be used a single time if you lose your authenticator.

errors.disable: Two-factor could not be turned off.

twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code carrying the enrolment secret for an authenticator app

password.title: Password
password.revokesOthers: This signs you out everywhere else.

errors.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
errors.generic: The password could not be changed.

advice.longer: Length helps more than anything else — aim for sixteen characters or a short phrase.
advice.repeats: Too few distinct characters: a long password made of three letters is a short one.
advice.sequence: Contains a run from the keyboard or the alphabet, which is guessed early.
advice.oneWord: A single word is a dictionary entry, whatever its length.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Where your account is currently signed in.
sessions.revokeFailed: The session could not be ended.

operations.errorDescription: The API did not answer. Retry, or check the service health.
operations.emptyDescription: Records appear here as soon as there are any.
operations.noMatchesDescription: No record matches the current filter.

dashboard.noRevenue: No settled orders in this window.
dashboard.revenueDefinition: Three separate figures. Provider money and wallet credit are not added together: wallet credit was already counted as revenue when the balance was funded.

revenue.title: Where the money came from
revenue.definition: {orders, plural, one {# settled order} other {# settled orders}} in this window. The three figures are never added: wallet spend was already counted as revenue when the balance was funded.

status.active: Customer records that are neither suspended nor deleted. Not the same as having a live subscription.
status.suspended: Customer records an operator has suspended.
status.deleted: Customer records marked deleted under the retention policy.

created.window: Customer records created inside the reporting window.

entitlement.active: Entitlements marked active whose end instant is still in the future.
entitlement.limited: Entitlements in the limited state, typically past a traffic or device cap.
entitlement.lapsed: Entitlements still marked active or limited whose end instant has passed.

renewal.window: Active entitlements ending inside the reporting window.

traffic.observed: The traffic counter Omniflow last observed from Remnawave. Remnawave is authoritative; this is a snapshot, not a total.

succeeded.window: Payment intents that settled inside the reporting window.

payment.inflight: Payment intents currently pending, awaiting action, or processing.

failed.window: Payment intents that failed inside the reporting window.

payment.stuck: Payment intents in flight and untouched for longer than any supported provider should take.

support.open: Support tickets in the open state.
support.stale: Open tickets with no message for a day or more.

job.failed: Fulfillment operations that exhausted their retries.
job.overdue: Queued fulfillment operations whose next attempt was due some time ago.

unprocessed.window: Provider callbacks received but not yet processed.

unverified.window: Provider callbacks whose signature did not verify.

drift.open: Unresolved differences between Omniflow and Remnawave.
drift.missing_remote: Entitlements whose Remnawave user no longer exists.

outbox.unpublished: Domain events the publisher has not yet drained.
outbox.oldest_age: Age of the oldest unpublished event. A large backlog of fresh events is healthy; one old event is not.

charts.customerMixDescription: Every customer record by the state it is in. A record is not the same as a live subscription.
charts.subscriptionMixDescription: Entitlements by lifecycle state. Renewals due are inside the active share and are not drawn twice.
charts.paymentMixDescription: Intents in the window by outcome. Stuck intents are inside the in-flight share.
charts.backlogDescription: What is waiting, largest first. These are separate queues, so the lengths compare but never add.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Search by an identifier you already hold, then work through the customer's subscriptions, orders, wallet, and risk history.
customers.notFoundDescription: No customer record matches that identifier.

filters.queryPlaceholder: Customer ID, Telegram ID, or Remnawave username

wallet.title: Adjust balance
wallet.description: A positive amount credits, a negative one debits. A debit cannot exceed the balance.
wallet.reason: Reason (shown to the customer if notified)
wallet.insufficient: The balance is lower than that.
wallet.failed: The balance could not be adjusted.

message.title: Message the customer
message.description: The bot delivers it to the customer in Telegram, exactly as written.
message.failed: The message could not be sent.

empty.riskDescription: No blocklist source lists any identifier for this customer.

devices.title: Devices
devices.unavailable: Devices are unavailable — Remnawave did not answer.

referrals.noInvitees: This customer has not invited anybody.
referrals.privacy: Invitees are identified only by their Omniflow identifier and whether they bought anything. Their account details are not part of this view.

timeline.emptyDescription: Operator actions against this customer appear here.

pause.pauseWarning: Access stops immediately and the remaining days stop counting down. Resuming gives back exactly the time the pause took.
pause.resumeWarning: Access returns and the expiry moves forward by the length of the pause.
pause.notPausable: That subscription is not in a state that can be paused or resumed.

merge.title: Merge into another account
merge.description: Joins this account into another one. Everything transferable moves, this record is closed and points at the survivor, and nothing can be undone afterwards.
merge.intoHint: Paste the identifier of the account this one should be folded into. The account you are looking at is the one being absorbed.
merge.reason: Why — recorded in the audit trail and both histories
merge.previewFailed: The preview could not be read
merge.confirmWarning: There is no undo. Subscriptions, orders, identities, tickets, and the wallet balance move to the other account, and this record is closed.
merge.confirmPrompt: Type this account's identifier to confirm.

blocker.same_account: An account cannot be merged into itself.
blocker.already_merged: This account has already been merged into another one.
blocker.target_merged: The other account is itself a merged account, which would leave everything two hops from where anybody looks.
blocker.account_deleted: One of the accounts is in the retention workflow. Merging would move records out from under a deletion somebody asked for.
blocker.referral_between: One of these accounts referred the other. Merging would make a customer their own referrer, and a reward was paid for that signup.

note.wallet_moves: The wallet balance moves as ledger entries — the source debited, the target credited — rather than by rewriting financial history.
note.subscriptions_renumbered: Both accounts hold subscriptions, so the moved ones take new slot numbers on the surviving account.
note.trial_carried: The surviving account will count as having claimed a trial, because trial abuse controls count customers rather than accounts.
note.cart_cancelled: A saved cart on this account is cancelled rather than moved: only one cart may be open per customer.
note.default_method_kept: The surviving account keeps its default payment method; methods moved from here arrive as non-default.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Order history, the reconciliation queue, and automatic charges that did not go through.

empty.stuckDescription: Every payment in flight is still inside the expected window.
empty.chargesDescription: Every automatic renewal in the recent history went through.

finance.chargesNote: A failed charge retries on a bounded schedule and then hands the customer back to manual renewal. Nothing here re-triggers one.

detail.description: Every payment attempt and refund against this order.
detail.noIntents: No payment was attempted for this order.
detail.refundReasonPlaceholder: Why this refund is being issued
detail.minorUnitsHint: The amount is an integer in the currency's minor unit. The payment service executes the refund against whatever the provider actually supports.

reports.title: Sales
reports.description: What was sold over a period you choose, broken down by kind of sale, by plan, and by day. The dashboard's thirty-day window stays fixed so that two visits compare; this is the one that moves.
reports.failed: The report could not be read

period.title: Period
period.description: Days are bucketed in {timezone}, which is this browser's timezone.

trials.title: Trial conversion
trials.cohort: Of the trials claimed in this period, how many of those customers have since paid for anything. A period ending today reads low: a trial claimed yesterday has had a day to convert.

operations.title: By kind of sale
operations.description: Provider money and wallet balance are shown apart and must not be added: the balance was already revenue when it was funded.

plans.title: By plan
plans.description: Read off the plan version each order actually referenced, so a price change since then does not re-price the sale.

daily.title: Provider money by day
daily.description: One chart per currency. Two currencies on one axis would assert that a hundred of one is a hundred of the other.

refunds.title: Refunds issued
refunds.description: By the date the refund was issued, not the date of the sale it reverses — so a closed month stays closed.

channels.failed: The channel report could not be loaded.
channels.empty: No attributed orders in this period.
channels.emptyAbout: An order appears here once a visitor arrived through a tagged link and agreed to measurement.
channels.about: Keyed on when the money arrived, not when the order was created.

ordersDaily.title: Orders per day
ordersDaily.description: How many orders were placed each day, across every currency. An order is an order whatever it settled in.

planChart.title: Revenue by plan
planChart.description: The eight highest-earning plan versions. Everything else stays in the table.

paymentHealth.title: Settlement by provider
paymentHealth.description: Two rates, because a customer abandoning a checkout and a gateway refusing a card are not the same event. Settlement is settled ÷ (settled + failed) — the provider's own success rate. Completion adds the customers who walked away.
paymentHealth.emptyDescription: Nothing was attempted through any provider in this window.

webhooks.title: Webhook intake
webhooks.description: Settlement and notification fail independently: a gateway that takes the money and cannot deliver the callback looks healthy to the customer and produces a stuck queue here. A non-zero rejected count is a rotated secret or somebody probing the endpoint.

daily.title: By day
daily.description: What turns "our settlement rate is 80%" into "it was 97% until Tuesday".

outcomes.title: What happened to each intent
outcomes.description: Settled, failed, and abandoned per provider. Intents still in flight are not plotted: one created minutes ago has not failed.
outcomes.empty: No intent has reached an outcome in this period.

traffic.title: Traffic
traffic.description: Read live from Remnawave on every request. Omniflow stores none of it — Remnawave owns traffic, nodes, and connections, and there is no history here because keeping one would be the first step towards Omniflow having an opinion about traffic.
traffic.failed: The report could not be read

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Sorted by pressure: nodes with a limit first, by how close they are to it.
nodes.noneHint: The panel answered with an empty list.

detail.nodes_unsupported: This Remnawave panel does not expose a node listing. Everything else on this page is unaffected.
detail.nodes_unavailable: The panel could not be reached for node figures. This is a connection problem rather than an absence of nodes.
detail.remnawave_not_configured: No Remnawave connection is configured for this installation.

consumers.title: Heaviest users
consumers.description: The fifty largest consumers in the current cycle.
consumers.partial: The fifty largest consumers among the {scanned} users scanned, of {total}. A longer user base is read in pages and this report stops before the request would.
consumers.emptyHint: The panel reported no users, so there is nothing to rank.

charts.pressureDescription: How full each limited node is right now. Nodes without a limit are not plotted: they cannot fill up.
charts.pressureEmpty: No limited node is carrying traffic.
charts.consumersDescription: The ten largest of the {scanned} users scanned, out of {total}.
charts.consumersEmpty: Nobody in the scanned set has used anything.

content.title: Information pages
content.description: The FAQ, the terms, the offer, and the privacy policy, published at addresses of your own. Anybody can read them without signing in — which is the point, because payment providers and application stores require an offer and a privacy policy at a stable address.
content.deleteWarning: This takes the address with it. If a payment provider approved that URL, the approval breaks. Withdrawing instead keeps the page and takes it out of the world reversibly.

list.title: Pages
list.description: A published page answers at its address for anybody. A draft answers 404 until you publish it.
list.emptyHint: Nothing is published, so /pages is empty and the customer panel links nowhere.

editor.listedHint: Off keeps the address and hides the link.
editor.syntax: The body is plain text. `## ` starts a heading, `- ` a bullet, `1. ` a numbered item, a blank line ends a block, and [text](https://…) is a link. There is no bold, no image, and no HTML — what you type is rendered as text, so nothing here can become markup on the page.
editor.bodyHint: Up to 40 000 characters. Links must be https.

risk.title: Risk
risk.description: Blocklist matches and anomaly signals, with the evidence that produced them.
risk.noAutoAction: Nothing on this page changes a customer. A decision here records a verdict and a reason; suspending an account is a separate action on the customer's own page.

empty.matchesDescription: No blocklist match is waiting for a decision.
empty.anomaliesDescription: No metric has crossed its configured threshold.
empty.sourcesDescription: Add a source to check customer identifiers against a published list.

rules.explainer: A metric with no rule is not evaluated at all. Thresholds are in each metric's own unit, and a condition that persists raises one signal per window rather than one per sweep.
rules.incoherent: The alert threshold must be at least the warning threshold, and the window at least five minutes. A rule that fails this is skipped at evaluation time.

units.purchase: Paid order value per customer, in the currency's minor unit.
units.refund: Refunded value per customer, in the currency's minor unit.
units.referral: Qualified referrals per inviter, as a count.
units.traffic: Observed usage per subscription, in bytes. Remnawave owns traffic, so this is a level check rather than a rate.

sources.httpsOnly: HTTPS only. Over plain HTTP anyone on the path could decide who this installation refuses to serve.

system.title: System
system.description: Fulfillment jobs, provider callbacks, Remnawave drift, and the outbox backlog.

empty.jobsDescription: Every fulfillment operation has succeeded or is still retrying.
empty.driftDescription: Omniflow and Remnawave agree on every entitlement.
empty.outboxDescription: Every domain event has been published.

health.dependenciesDescription: The same probes the readiness endpoint reports on, so the panel and your load balancer can never disagree about whether a dependency is up.
health.providersDescription: What each configured provider last reported. "Configured but never reached" is a different problem from "reached and failing", so they are shown separately from the live probes above.
health.maintenanceDescription: Blocks new purchases and defers fulfillment. It never cancels, refunds, or expires anything already paid for.
health.reasonPlaceholder: Why maintenance is being engaged or cleared
health.noticesRequired: Both languages are required. A customer who reads only one and gets a blank screen is worse served than one who gets a notice they can read.
health.automaticNote: This was engaged by dependency detection, not by an operator. It clears itself when the dependency recovers; clearing it by hand would re-enable purchases while the dependency is still down.

errors.title: Error log
errors.description: Errors the api, bot, and worker logged, grouped so a repeating failure is one row. A new error is announced in the operator group's Errors topic without its message.
errors.failed: The error log could not be loaded.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Plans, their versions, and the promotions that discount them.

empty.plansDescription: Create a plan before opening the catalog to customers.

version.title: Publish the next version
version.description: A plan version is immutable once an order references it, so this publishes a new one instead of changing the current one.
version.graceHint: Access continues this long after expiry. Zero disables it.
version.trafficHint: Leave empty for unlimited. Zero is not the same thing.
version.squadsHint: Every subscription on this version gets these Remnawave squads.
version.maxSquadsHint: Leave empty for no upper bound.

downgradePolicyValue.at_expiry: At the end of the period

cancellationPolicyValue.at_expiry: At the end of the period

trialEligibilityValue.never_trialled: Anyone who never had a trial

version.pricesHint: One row per currency the plan is sold in, with the price as a customer reads it, such as 499.00.
version.reasonHint: Why this version is being published.
version.immutability: Existing orders keep the version they were bought at. Publishing does not change any price a customer has already paid.
version.offeredSquadsHint: Each one is a checkbox at checkout, with the label shown in that language.
version.externalSquadHint: Shapes the subscription page and client configuration in Remnawave. Leave empty for none.

empty.title: No add-ons
empty.description: Add-ons let a customer buy extra traffic, device slots, or squads on top of a plan.

composer.title: Create an add-on
composer.description: The add-on row carries presentation and stays editable; the version carries what the customer gets and what it costs, and does not.

payloadHint.devices: Added to the subscription's device limit.

composer.quantityHint: How many of this add-on one order may include.
composer.pricesHint: One row per currency the add-on is sold in, with the price as a customer reads it, such as 199.00.
composer.immutability: Both languages are required. Saving publishes a new version; orders already placed keep the version they were bought at.

squadPicker.search: Search by name or paste an ID
squadPicker.unavailable: The Remnawave panel did not answer; paste a squad ID instead.

planOptions.title: Plan settings
planOptions.description: Apply to every version of the plan and reach existing subscriptions the next time they are pushed to Remnawave.
planOptions.tagHint: Up to 16 capital letters, digits, and underscores. Empty falls back to the trial or paid tag in Settings → Commerce.

codes.title: Wholesale code batches
codes.description: Generate a block of codes at an agreed price, hand over the list, and revoke whatever is left if the list leaks. A code grants the plan version it was issued against; the money changes hands outside Omniflow, which is what wholesale means.
codes.emptyHint: Nothing has been issued to a distributor.
codes.revokeWarning: This kills the {count} codes nobody has redeemed. Codes already redeemed are untouched: somebody is using the subscription each one produced, and taking that back is a different decision.
codes.revokeReason: Why — recorded in the audit trail

generated.title: {count} codes generated
generated.onlyCopy: This is the only copy. Only their SHA-256 is stored, so nothing in the panel or the database can show them again. Download or copy them before dismissing this.
generated.dismissWarning: They cannot be shown again. If you have not saved them, the batch is unusable and you will have to generate another.

form.title: New batch
form.description: Up to {max} codes in one batch. A larger arrangement is several batches, which is what a distributor's own order structure looks like anyway.
form.referenceHint: What you will search for when the distributor emails about it.
form.price: Agreed price per code, in minor units
form.priceHint: Recorded, not charged. Zero is allowed — a batch given away for a partnership is a real thing.
form.expiryHint: Leave empty and the codes never expire, which is a liability you then carry.

shop.title: Digital goods
shop.description: Telegram Premium and Stars sold alongside subscriptions. Nothing here touches a VPN entitlement.

empty.productsDescription: Add a product and a pricing rule before opening the shop.
empty.providersDescription: Configure a digital-goods provider to sell Premium or Stars.
empty.reviewDescription: No delivery is waiting on a human decision.

pricing.noPublishedCost: This provider publishes no cost for Telegram Premium, so the price must be fixed. The margin on such an order is recorded as unknown rather than as the whole price.
pricing.minorUnitsHint: Enter the price as a customer reads it, such as 499.00. 1500 basis points is a 15% markup, and every rounding mode rounds up.

shop.reviewExplainer: The gateway honours no idempotency key, so a lost answer means the goods may or may not have been sent. Check with the provider, then record what you found — confirming delivery completes the order, and refunding credits the customer's wallet.
shop.reviewReasonPlaceholder: What you confirmed with the provider (required)

stars.statusUnavailable: The provider's state could not be read
stars.dryRunExplainer: Dry run is on: orders pass through every state, but nothing is bought on Fragment and no TON leaves the wallet.
stars.secretsHint: The Fragment cookies, the wallet's seed phrase, and the TON API key are read from APP_FRAGMENT_* environment variables only. They are never stored, shown, or logged.
stars.walletUnavailable: The wallet could not be read

actions.reason: Reason (required, kept in the audit log)
actions.retryTitle: Send the order to Fragment again?
actions.retryExplainer: Only after checking the wallet's outgoing transfers: if this order's payment did leave, retrying pays for the same Stars a second time.
actions.refundExplainer: What the customer paid goes back to their wallet. Refund only if the payment did not leave, or the Stars will be both delivered and refunded.
actions.completeExplainer: Use this when the wallet shows the payment went through and the Stars reached the recipient.

setup.title: Sell Stars by amount
setup.description: Creates the product the bot's “Buy Stars” button and the web shop sell: the customer picks an amount between the bounds and pays a fixed price per Star.
setup.badBounds: The minimum must be at least 50 (Fragment's floor) and not above the maximum.

provisioning.label: Setting up
provisioning.description: Your subscription is being set up. You can leave this page — it carries on without you.

completed.label: Done
completed.description: Everything is paid for and set up. Your subscription is ready to use.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: This did not go through. If money left your account, it is returned automatically — contact support if it does not.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: This order was cancelled and nothing was charged.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: The payment window closed before this was paid. Nothing was charged; order again when you are ready.

refunded.label: Refunded
refunded.description: This order was refunded. The money is on its way back by the route it arrived.

unknown.label: In progress
unknown.description: This order is being processed. Check again in a moment.

fulfillment.title: Setting up your subscription
fulfillment.attempts: {count, plural, one {# attempt so far} other {# attempts so far}}

status.retrying: Being retried after a hitch. This normally resolves itself.
status.failed: This could not be completed. Support has been notified and can put it right.
status.cancelled: This was stopped before it finished.

hosted.title: Finish on the payment page
hosted.description: The payment opens on the provider's own page. Come back here afterwards — this page shows the result either way.

telegram_invoice.title: Pay in Telegram
telegram_invoice.description: Telegram Stars are paid inside the chat. Open the bot and it sends you the invoice for this order; pay it there, then come back — this page updates on its own.

incomplete.title: The payment has not started
incomplete.description: The provider did not accept the request when this order was opened. Try the payment again below, or choose another method from the order.

unreachable.title: Finish this payment in the bot
unreachable.description: This method is paid inside Telegram, and the link to the bot could not be built right now. Open the bot from Telegram and pay the order from its orders list.

manual.title: Waiting for an operator
manual.description: Your transfer is checked by a person, so this can take a few hours. If you have not been told where to send it, ask below.
manual.ask: Ask where to send the payment

none.title: Nothing left to pay
none.description: Your wallet covered this order in full.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: The amount above is still outstanding. Start the payment when you are ready.
payment.noMethod: No payment method can settle this order right now. Cancel it and order again from the store, or contact support.
payment.nothingDue: Nothing more was owed on this order.
payment.saveMethod: Save this card for automatic renewal
payment.saveMethodHint: Only a reference from the payment provider is kept — never the card number. You can remove it at any time under Auto-renew.

wallet.reservedHint: An order you have not paid for yet has claimed part of your balance. Paying or cancelling it releases the amount.

ledger.title: History
ledger.emptyDescription: Top-ups, purchases, and refunds all appear here as they happen.

topUp.title: Add to wallet
topUp.disabled: Topping up is switched off on this service. Your balance can still be spent on a purchase.
topUp.remaining: You may still add {amount} in this period.
topUp.startedDescription: {amount} lands in your wallet as soon as the payment is confirmed. This page does not need to stay open.
topUp.forShop: Your shop purchase is saved. Top up {amount} and it is bought automatically as soon as the payment lands.

pending.title: Waiting to be paid
pending.noPayment: The payment for this top-up has not been started. Open the order to choose a method.

redeem.title: Promo or gift code
redeem.label: Code
redeem.hint: Codes for days, a trial, or wallet credit are applied here. Enter a discount code at checkout.
redeem.extended: Code applied — your subscription updates within a minute
redeem.refused: That code cannot be used or was already used.
redeem.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.

renewal.description: Renew a subscription automatically before it ends, from your wallet or a saved card. Turning it on is your consent to be charged; you can turn it off at any time.
renewal.loadFailed: Could not load your renewal settings. Try again.
renewal.unavailable: Automatic renewal is not offered on this service right now.
renewal.notSupported: No payment method can renew this plan automatically.
renewal.leadTimeDays: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before
renewal.noMethods: No saved cards. Tick “Save this card” when you pay to add one.
renewal.removeDescription: Renewals that use it switch to your next saved card, or pause if none is left.
renewal.methodsNotice: Only a reference from the payment provider is stored — never the card number or expiry.

gifts.buyDescription: Pay for somebody else's subscription and pass them the code. The code is shown once — keep it.
gifts.failed: The gift could not be bought. Check your balance and try again.
gifts.codeHint: The recipient enters it in the bot (🔑 Redeem a code) or on the wallet page. It is not shown anywhere else.
gifts.paidFromWallet: Paid from your balance — the code works now.
gifts.emptySent: You have not sent a gift yet.
gifts.redeemHint: Got a gift? Enter the code on the <link>wallet page</link>.

analytics.title: Measurement
analytics.request: We would like to measure how people find this site, so we know which advertising is worth paying for. Nothing about your subscription is involved either way.

errors.currency: Use a three-letter currency code, such as RUB.

money.precision: {decimals, plural, =0 {This currency has no fractional units; enter a whole number.} one {Use at most # decimal place.} other {Use at most # decimal places.}}

errors.secretRequired: The address this credential is sent to changed, so the stored one will not be sent there. Enter it again to save.
errors.secretKeptIfUnchanged: Left empty, the stored credential is kept only if the address is unchanged. If you changed the address, enter it again.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or what it pointed to was removed.

error.title: This page could not be shown
error.description: Something failed while loading it. Nothing you entered was lost — try again, or go elsewhere and come back.

copy.failed: This browser did not allow copying

openApp.title: Open the app
openApp.description: Your browser should hand over to the VPN app now. If it asks, allow it.
openApp.hint: Nothing happened? Install the app first, then tap the button again.
openApp.invalidDescription: It does not point to an app. Go back to the bot and tap the button again.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from e-mails
unsubscribe.description: Stop news and offers by e-mail? Receipts and messages about your account will still arrive.
unsubscribe.done: Done. You will not receive news and offers by e-mail any more.
unsubscribe.invalid: This unsubscribe link is not valid. Open it from the e-mail again.
unsubscribe.failed: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
